To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the environment, which we define as the sum total of all the sensory stimuli that a participant experiences in the virtual world and that is constructed by the participant in the course of the virtual experience, is what establishes presence.
presence is achieved by the construction of a dynamic environment that is perceived as salient.
the environment is an emergent process that is a metonym for nonself, sound is an emergant perception, and presence is a function of the environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of what makes a virtual world a virtual world.
the role that environment plays in the formation of presence and how this is achieved through sound.
the design and development of virtual worlds that are capable of supporting presence.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
presence is achieved through the process of environment construction, and that the environment is constructed by the process of salience.
sound is the primary means of presence in a virtual world.
the environment, as a salient construct, is the primary means by which the virtual world is experienced and it is this environment which establishes the means for the experience of presence.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the virtual world is a dynamic, emergent environment that functions as a salient construct for the nonself and that it is this salience that establishes the means to presence.
presence is achieved by a process that is the product of the environment, which is itself a dynamic and emergent construct, and the environment is achieved by the process of sound.
sound is a necessary condition for presence.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the environment is not an object to be designed, but a process that is the result of the interaction of the user with the world.
presence is not an end in itself but is a means to an end.
sound is a key factor in establishing presence and that the environment is the key construct that establishes presence in virtual worlds.
